solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique after crossings); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Entertainer, mature, one detained

parts.note: a host entertains guests
to age is to mature

explanation.surface: A list of descriptions of a performer, apparently held captive.
explanation.definitionFit: A hostage is a person held prisoner as security, so someone detained against their will.

clue.text: Reportedly, man's in the shade

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said or heard, so we want a word that sounds like another

parts.note: Hugh is a man's name

explanation.surface: Rumour has it some fellow is resting out of the sun.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the shade' pictures someone out of the sunlight, but 'shade' is the definition in its sense of a colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A shade is a variety or tint of a colour, which is what a hue is.

clue.text: Fighter's aura is stirring, gripping male

indicators.note: gripping means holding inside, so the anagram goes around the letter for male
stirring mixes things up, so the letters of aura and is are rearranged

explanation.surface: A boxer's charisma is moving, captivating a man.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged letters of AURA IS give SAURAI, and that grips M.
explanation.definitionFit: A samurai was a member of Japan's warrior class, a professional sword fighter.

clue.text: Girl's pannier missing outside

indicators.note: losing its outside letters leaves only the inner part of the word pannier

explanation.surface: A girl has mislaid her basket somewhere outdoors.
explanation.definitionFit: Annie is a common female given name, so it stands for a girl in crossword style.

clue.text: No spiel, surprisingly, in letter from Greece

indicators.note: surprisingly suggests the letters of no spiel come out in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A letter sent from Greece, unexpectedly, contains no sales pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsilon is the fifth character of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Quickly stuck

explanation.walkthrough: The two words look unrelated, and they are: one word covers both speed and being fixed in place.
explanation.definitionFit: The adverb covers both rapid movement and being firmly held, as when a boat is held fast.

clue.text: Love affair makes Scottish reel

definitions.meaning: second meaning: the Highland ..., a lively Scottish dance

explanation.surface: A romance begins at a Highland dance.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a short romantic relationship and a vigorous traditional Scottish dance, the Highland fling.

clue.text: Game from oil era, it's newly ordered

indicators.note: newly ordered means put into a fresh arrangement, so these letters are reshuffled

explanation.surface: A game dating from the age of oil has been brought back in a new form.
explanation.definitionFit: Solitaire is a card or peg game played by one person on their own.

clue.text: One who'll agree seeing desire to accommodate son, mother

indicators.note: to accommodate is to take in, so the word for desire holds the other pieces

parts.note: a yen is a longing or desire
S is the genealogy abbreviation for son
Ma is an informal word for mother

explanation.surface: Someone compliant is keen to put up a son and his mother.
explanation.walkthrough: YEN, a craving, takes in S and MA to give YE-SMA-N.
explanation.definitionFit: A yes-man is a sycophant who always assents to whatever the boss says.

clue.text: Protection, quiet, that is given to Lord briefly

parts.note: sh is the call for quiet
i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is
Ld is the short form of Lord in titles

explanation.surface: A noble is quietly offered security.
explanation.definitionFit: A shield is armour carried to guard against blows, hence anything that protects.

clue.text: What might reveal sight, including tree, extremely typical

indicators.note: including means containing, so the word sight holds the other letters
extremely points to the extremes, the first and last letters of typical

explanation.surface: A cryptic hint about something that helps you see, with a tree in the picture.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as a riddle: a lamp by the roadside lights up a tree, which is why the definition is so loose.
explanation.definitionFit: A lamp on a post illuminates the road at night, so it reveals what would otherwise be unseen.

clue.text: Exploding star — a sun? Prove that's wrong

indicators.note: wrong suggests the letters of a sun and prove are disordered

explanation.surface: An astronomer is challenged to show that a burst star is really a sun.
explanation.definitionFit: A supernova is the brilliant explosion of a dying massive star.

clue.text: Period of year with time for good race

indicators.note: time for good means the letter for time takes the place of the letter for good

parts.note: spring is a season of the year

explanation.surface: A good race held at a certain season of the year.
explanation.walkthrough: In SPRING, the G (good) is swapped for T (time).
explanation.definitionFit: A sprint is a short race run at top speed.

clue.text: Muscle comes in instant, leading to postscript

indicators.note: leading to means coming before, so the word for instant precedes the abbreviation

parts.note: a trice is an instant, as in 'in a trice'

explanation.surface: A muscle twinges in a moment, prompting an afterthought in a letter.
explanation.definitionFit: The triceps is the large muscle at the back of the upper arm.

clue.text: Served in unit with foolish person

indicators.note: served in suggests the answer is contained within the words unit with

explanation.surface: A soldier did service in a regiment alongside a fool.
explanation.definitionFit: A nitwit is an idiot, a silly or stupid person.

clue.text: Sun's effect on fellow, touching

parts.note: the sun gives the skin a tan
a gent is a man or fellow

explanation.surface: How the sun has changed a man is moving to see.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Touching' looks like it means moving or emotional; here it is the geometric sense.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangent line meets a curve at one point without crossing it, so it is touching it.

clue.text: New dawn since arenas rebuilt

indicators.note: rebuilt means constructed again in a new form, so these letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A fresh start for a town after its stadiums have been reconstructed.
explanation.definitionFit: A renaissance is a revival or rebirth, a fresh beginning after decline.

clue.text: Initially not appreciating Robert, powerful guy

indicators.note: initially means at the start, so take the first letters of not and appreciating

parts.note: Bob is the short form of Robert

explanation.surface: From the start, nobody valued Robert, a man of influence.
explanation.definitionFit: A nabob is a wealthy, influential person, originally a provincial governor in Mughal India.

clue.text: Brown, private investigator, seen in water

indicators.note: seen in means appearing inside, so the detective's letters go within the word for water

parts.note: the sea is a body of water

explanation.surface: A detective named Brown is spotted swimming.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Brown' reads as a detective's surname, but it is the colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Sepia is a reddish-brown pigment, the colour of old photographs.

clue.text: Practical party, skilled

parts.note: a do is a party or social event
able means capable or skilled

explanation.surface: A list describing a sensible, competent party.
explanation.definitionFit: Something doable is feasible or achievable, which is what practical means here.

clue.text: Quite attractive

definitions.meaning: second meaning: pleasing to look at

explanation.walkthrough: It reads as 'rather good-looking', but the two words are separate senses of one word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word serves as an adverb meaning fairly and as an adjective meaning good-looking.

clue.text: Weight not brought up

indicators.note: in a down clue, brought up means read from bottom to top, so not is turned around

explanation.surface: A weight that has not been lifted.
explanation.definitionFit: A ton is a unit of mass, 2,240 pounds in Britain.

clue.text: Clothing boast rebuffed

indicators.note: rebuffed suggests being pushed back, so the word for boast is read backwards

parts.note: to brag is to boast

explanation.surface: A show-off's bragging about outfits is snubbed.
explanation.definitionFit: Garb is clothing, especially a distinctive costume or dress.

clue.text: Section in old hospital with no luxuries

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the word for section goes inside the word for hospital

parts.note: san is a dated short form of sanatorium, a hospital
a part is a section

explanation.surface: A ward in a former hospital had nothing comfortable.
explanation.definitionFit: Spartan means austere and frugal, like the famously disciplined people of ancient Sparta.
